ingredients: spaghetti, eggs, parmesan cheese, bacon, black pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Fry bacon until crispy. Beat eggs and mix with grated parmesan. Combine pasta with bacon and egg mixture. Season with pepper and serve hot.

ingredients: chicken, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, curry powder, salt, oil
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté onions, garlic, and ginger. Add tomatoes and cook down. Add chicken and curry powder. Simmer until chicken is cooked through. Serve with rice.

ingredients: bread slices, cheddar cheese, butter
instructions: Butter the bread slices. Place cheese between two slices. Grill on a pan until golden brown and cheese melts.

ingredients: flour, milk, eggs, sugar, baking powder, salt, butter
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Whisk in milk and eggs. Heat butter in a pan and pour batter. Cook until bubbles form, flip and cook the other side.

ingredients: rice, mixed vegetables, soy sauce, garlic, egg, oil
instructions: Cook rice and let it cool. Scramble egg in a pan. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables. Add rice, soy sauce, and mix well.

ingredients: tomatoes, onion, garlic, vegetable broth, cream, salt, pepper
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add chopped tomatoes and broth. Simmer and blend. Add cream and season before serving.

ingredients: lettuce, croutons, parmesan, Caesar dressing, chicken (optional)
instructions: Chop lettuce and toss with croutons and grated parmesan. Add dressing and grilled chicken if desired.

ingredients: bread slices, eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar, butter
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon. Dip bread slices. Fry on buttered pan until golden brown.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, oil, salt
instructions: Heat oil. Add garlic and ginger. Stir-fry veggies. Add soy sauce and cook until tender.

ingredients: ground beef, taco shells, onion, tomato, lettuce, cheese, taco seasoning
instructions: Cook beef with taco seasoning. Fill taco shells with beef, chopped veggies, and cheese.

ingredients: potatoes, butter, milk, salt, pepper
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft. Mash with butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper.

ingredients: eggs, onion, tomato, cheese, salt, pepper, oil
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Pour into pan. Add chopped veggies and cheese. Cook until firm.

ingredients: flour, sugar, butter, eggs, chocolate chips, vanilla extract, baking soda
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix in eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and chips. Scoop and bake until golden.

ingredients: macaroni, cheddar cheese, milk, butter, flour, salt
instructions: Cook macaroni. Make cheese sauce with butter, flour, milk, and cheese. Mix with pasta and bake if desired.

ingredients: ripe bananas, flour, sugar, eggs, butter, baking soda
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with sugar, eggs, and butter. Add flour and baking soda. Pour into loaf pan and bake.

ingredients: burger buns, veggie patties, lettuce, tomato, onion, cheese, sauce
instructions: Cook patties. Assemble burgers with veggies, cheese, and sauce in buns.

ingredients: chicken, tomato puree, cream, butter, spices, garlic, ginger
instructions: Marinate chicken in spices. Cook in butter, add tomato puree and cream. Simmer until rich.

ingredients: baguette, garlic, butter, parsley, salt
instructions: Mix garlic with butter and parsley. Spread on bread. Bake until golden and crisp.

ingredients: noodles, vegetables, soy sauce, garlic, oil
instructions: Boil noodles. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables. Add noodles and soy sauce. Toss well.

ingredients: ground beef, beans, tomatoes, chili powder, onion, garlic, salt
instructions: Cook beef with onion and garlic. Add beans, tomatoes, and chili powder. Simmer until thick.

ingredients: rice, egg, green onion, soy sauce, garlic, oil
instructions: Scramble egg in a pan. Add cooked rice, garlic, soy sauce, and green onions. Stir-fry well.

ingredients: pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil, olive oil
instructions: Spread sauce on dough. Top with mozzarella and basil. Bake until cheese melts.

ingredients: bread, canned tuna, mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, salt
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo. Layer with lettuce and tomato in bread slices.

ingredients: tomato, cucumber, feta, olives, red onion, olive oil
instructions: Chop vegetables. Toss with feta, olives, and olive oil.

ingredients: chicken, basmati rice, yogurt, onion, spices, saffron
instructions: Marinate chicken. Cook with onions and spices. Layer with rice and saffron. Steam until done.

ingredients: mozzarella, tomato, basil, olive oil, balsamic vinegar
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes. Layer with basil. Drizzle with oil and vinegar.

ingredients: bell peppers, rice, ground beef, onion, tomato sauce, cheese
instructions: Stuff bell peppers with cooked beef and rice. Top with sauce and cheese. Bake until tender.

ingredients: fish fillets, taco shells, cabbage, lime, mayonnaise
instructions: Cook fish. Assemble tacos with shredded cabbage and lime mayo sauce.

ingredients: fettuccine, chicken, cream, parmesan, garlic, butter
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté chicken with garlic. Add cream and parmesan. Combine with pasta.

ingredients: bread, avocado, lemon juice, chili flakes, salt
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread on toasted bread. Sprinkle chili flakes.

ingredients: mixed vegetables, broth, onion, garlic, herbs, salt
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add veggies and broth. Simmer with herbs until tender.

ingredients: chicken wings, BBQ sauce, garlic, salt, pepper
instructions: Marinate wings. Bake or grill while brushing with BBQ sauce.

ingredients: ramen noodles, broth, boiled egg, green onion, soy sauce
instructions: Cook noodles in broth. Add egg and soy sauce. Garnish with green onions.

ingredients: mango, yogurt, milk, honey, ice
instructions: Blend mango with yogurt, milk, and honey until smooth. Serve cold.

ingredients: eggs, mayonnaise, mustard, salt, pepper
instructions: Boil and chop eggs. Mix with mayo, mustard, salt, and pepper.

ingredients: ladyfingers, mascarpone, coffee, cocoa powder, sugar
instructions: Layer soaked ladyfingers with mascarpone cream. Dust with cocoa powder. Chill and serve.

ingredients: shrimp, garlic, butter, lemon juice, spaghetti
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter. Add shrimp and lemon juice. Toss with cooked spaghetti.

ingredients: falafel, pita bread, lettuce, tomato, tahini sauce
instructions: Place falafel in pita. Add veggies and drizzle tahini sauce.

ingredients: peanut butter, sugar, eggs, baking soda
instructions: Mix ingredients. Shape into cookies and bake until golden.

ingredients: eggplant, marinara sauce, mozzarella, parmesan, breadcrumbs
instructions: Bread and fry eggplant. Layer with sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

ingredients: ground lamb, mashed potatoes, peas, carrots, onion
instructions: Cook meat with vegetables. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake until golden.

ingredients: apples, flour, butter, sugar, cinnamon
instructions: Make filling with apples and cinnamon. Place in crust and bake until golden.

ingredients: chicken breast, flour, egg, breadcrumbs, salt
instructions: Coat chicken in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs. Fry until golden brown.

ingredients: zucchini, flour, egg, garlic, salt, pepper
instructions: Grate zucchini and mix with ingredients. Fry spoonfuls in oil until crisp.

ingredients: beef, onion, mushroom, sour cream, egg noodles
instructions: Sauté beef and veggies. Stir in sour cream. Serve over cooked noodles.

ingredients: yogurt, berries, granola, honey
instructions: Layer yogurt with berries and granola. Drizzle honey on top.

ingredients: flour, milk, eggs, sugar, butter
instructions: Whisk ingredients. Cook thin crepes in buttered pan. Fill as desired.

ingredients: tofu, vegetables, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, oil
instructions: Cook tofu until golden. Stir-fry with veggies and sauce.

ingredients: chickpeas, tomato, onion, garlic, ginger, spices
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger. Add tomatoes and spices. Stir in chickpeas and simmer.
